g.text: Measured clock and temperature during the bounded sweep
Clock: CPU0 APERF delta / wall time, including idle; sampled about every 0.25 s. APERF/MPERF ratio is retained in telemetry.csv.
Temperature is package-wide maximum, not solely the tested core. Gaps are cooldowns. Throttle counters are retained in telemetry.csv.
Run state: stopped; restoration verified: True. thermal throttle counter advanced
